advisories.text: Streams whose upstream is dynamic have an empty upstream label and are never pruned. The doc comment says so, but no test covers this case, and the empty label in the metrics merges all dynamic upstreams into one series.

No integration test checks the stream metrics end to end (for example scraping /metrics after a real stream closes), or that stream_timeout works on a detached stream. Both are covered only by unit tests.
Adding the streamLogLevel field leaves the following ctx/logger field alignment not gofmt-clean (`ctx   caddy.Context` next to `logger *zap.Logger`), which the lint gate may flag.

closeUpstream sets the shutdown reason for each connection of a stream, so setReason runs twice per stream (once for the front connection, once for the back). It is harmless, but setting it once per stream would be simpler.
